Overview of Castilla-La Mancha Region (Castilla-La Mancha)

Castilla-La Mancha Region (Castilla-La Mancha) is located in the Castilla-La Mancha region of Spain, with its prefectural capital at Toledo. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Toledo Imperial Historic Center, Cuenca Hanging Houses (Casas Colgadas), Consuegra & Campo de Criptana windmills, Almagro Corral de Comedias.

RegionCastilla-La Mancha
Capital cityToledo
Cities & municipalities25
Primary transport hubToledo Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail)

How to get to Castilla-La Mancha Region

AVE Avant high-speed shuttles from Madrid Puerta de Atocha to Toledo (33 min), Ciudad Real and Cuenca (55 min). Use our Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Castilla-La Mancha

When visiting cities across Castilla-La Mancha, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Queso Manchego DOP
  • Pisto Manchego
  • Mazapán de Toledo
  • Perdiz estofada
  • Valdepeñas & La Mancha wines

Best time to visit Castilla-La Mancha

Best time to visit Castilla-La Mancha: Mar–Jun, Sep–Nov.
